releaseEvidence: The official v8.4.0, v8.5.0, and v8.5.1 GitHub releases repeat the same member-label announcement.
The announcement covers member-authored labels, display beside the member's profile name, and administrator control through the Edit group info permission.
The repeated wording is consistent with the final implementation but does not identify a new v8.4.1-to-v8.5.0 delta.

implementationEvidence.testEvidenceNote: The base already tests dirty-state and validation rules, save and clear success, network and insufficient-rights failures, about-text override confirmation, administrator permission warnings, protocol application, and backup fixtures.

observedStateTransitions: Existing value -> valid changed draft -> InProgress -> Success.
Existing label -> cleared draft -> InProgress -> Success with no label.
All-members access -> warning because non-admin labels exist -> confirm and restrict, or cancel and preserve state.
InProgress -> NetworkError or InsufficientRights -> consumed error -> editable draft for correction or retry.
Successful first label with existing profile about text -> override warning -> dismissal -> Success.
